title: DraCor Textbook
description:
The DraCor Textbook is a curated, pedagogically structured Open Educational Resource (OER) for working with the programmable drama corpora of DraCor. This book covers corpus building, TEI encoding, the DraCor front-end, the DraCor API and the DraCor infrastructure.

The DraCor Textbook was developed as part of DraCorOS, a project funded through the OSCARS cascading grants.

Online edition: https://dracor-org.github.io/dracor-textbook/
